findings.title: SP-01 · P1 · Provider intake is disabled in production
findings.disposition: draft implementation validated in isolation; operational failure remains
findings.rootCause: Evidence: production context explicitly sets WORKER_PROVIDER_INTAKE_ENABLED=false; the five scheduler records in evidence/hosted-readonly-observations.json each contain worker.disabled. The latest saved intake receipt is failed, requested 2026-10-27 04:00:19.042908 UTC and finished 04:00:52.382725 UTC. The current deploy was published later, at 04:05:59.566 UTC. Earlier background telemetry reaches Calendar processing, then fails at Gmail processing with category provider after about 31.8 seconds total. Read-only reproduction: inspect the deployed flag, filter scheduler logs by FunctionName provider-intake, compare the receipt's times against deployment publication. Do not invoke the worker or flip the flag as an audit test. Impact: newly added provider lessons cannot be discovered by this worker while disabled. Existing portal lessons/projection work may still function. No evidence here establishes the original reason for disabling it or the exact Gmail error. Recommendation: retain the safety stop until the failure is understood; expose disabled state, selected source and last completed run in Settings; validate in staging, then obtain approval for production re-enablement and historical review. Publication gate: blocks a claim that intake is healthy.
findings.affectedWorkflowsAndConnections: Owner: integrations/operations. Roles: coach indirectly affects every portal role. Flows C01–C04/C06, F04/F05; X03/X04/X18/X19.
findings.proposedFix: Impact: newly added provider lessons cannot be discovered by this worker while disabled. Existing portal lessons/projection work may still function. No evidence here establishes the original reason for disabling it or the exact Gmail error. Recommendation: retain the safety stop until the failure is understood; expose disabled state, selected source and last completed run in Settings; validate in staging, then obtain approval for production re-enablement and historical review. Publication gate: blocks a claim that intake is healthy.

findings.remainingAcceptance: Controlled Calendar/Gmail errors/recovery and three real scheduler-origin completions; authenticated production-equivalent Settings; separate worker enablement approval.
findings.implementation: Private append-only run/stage observations, service-only claim fencing, disabled-aware health, preserved stage failure, receipt-following Settings; no fixed 15-second completion assumption.
findings.ci: Source implementation passed 40633111054 / 40633111028; documentation checkpoint 963c05b passed 40685577256 / 40685576886. Full isolated PostgreSQL, upgrade, grants, fencing and concurrency passed; real provider acceptance remains open.

findings.title: SP-03 · P1 · Manual datetime defaults and minimum mix UTC strings with local wall time
findings.disposition: manual input corrected; systemwide timezone acceptance incomplete
findings.rootCause: Recommendation: make the chosen timezone explicit; use one studio/viewer-aware wall-time converter for display and serialization; test UTC, New York, Los Angeles, positive offsets and DST gaps/folds. Verify that changing service or duration invalidates conflict approval. Publication gate: blocks confidence in this form's timezone behavior.
findings.affectedWorkflowsAndConnections: Owner: scheduling/time. B03/X13. The form writes toISOString().slice(0,16) into a datetime-local, then parses it with new Date(startsAt), which interprets the offset-free string in browser local time. In TZ=America/New_York, with now fixed to 2026-10-27T18:00Z (14:00 local), the minimum is 2026-10-27T18:00, parsed as 22:00Z: four hours later. The default three-days-ahead value similarly shifts. This proves the conversion mismatch; no specific existing production lesson is attributed to it.
findings.proposedFix: Recommendation: make the chosen timezone explicit; use one studio/viewer-aware wall-time converter for display and serialization; test UTC, New York, Los Angeles, positive offsets and DST gaps/folds.
